payload.text: **ST0007 D39, option A: the `releases` renderer's CHANGELOG header is generic, built from `project.name`, and the caret-on-0.x clause leaves the generated header** (hv, 2026-09-17, to dc in dc's session; relayed by dc, recorded by vc). The clause's one home is the `devbin_version` note in `docs/configuration.md`; the views are regenerated once, in WP-02; AC-2.1's "byte for byte" gains "apart from that clause". dc makes the `intent ac edit` and D39's RULED note as WP-02's first commit, after WP-01 lands. In the same session hv agreed that dc prepares WP-02 in parallel in its own worktree and wires nothing into the shared tree until WP-01 lands.
